name: pilot_boat
what: a 16 m pilot boat, aluminium, twin diesels on propellers, a wheelhouse amidships, fendered all round

signature.lights: white over red all-round (pilot on duty), masthead, sidelights, sternlight; 'PILOT' on the wheelhouse
signature.ir: two diesel exhausts at the transom, warm wheelhouse (~5 K over the sea)

behaviour: fast, direct between the pilot station and the ship it serves; talks on VHF
basis: 15-17 m aluminium pilot boats with twin 400-600 kW diesels, 20-25 kn; RCS of an aluminium superstructure; AIS class A by duty
